Built for
Service Providers’ Acceleration
Expert-Level Guidance at Every Step
Powered by AI, infused with unparalleled CISO knowledge, Cynomi acts as your CISO Copilot, delivering top-tier insights for impactful cybersecurity and compliance services.
Let Cynomi handle the heavy lifting for you. Empower your team to deliver high-quality, tailored solutions effortlessly with built-in CISO expertise, AI-driven guidance.
Out-of-the-Box Cybersecurity Management
Out-of-the-box yet tailored to each client to minimize manual effort, Cynomi leverages AI crafted with CISO experience to create a unique security profile per client, delivering client-specific security postures, policies, plans, and reports in no-time.
With Cynomi, you can automate time-consuming tasks, fast-track cybersecurity management, show value to your clients quickly and get more with your current resources.
Streamlined Cybersecurity and Compliance Management
Follow Cynomi’s built-in structured processes to streamline and standardize your team’s work, enabling seamless scalability and improved efficiency.
Standardize your processes and deliverables to consistently provide high-impact cybersecurity and compliance services that build client trust and drive results across your entire client base.
